faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Why do salons in Hauz Khas need a specialist salon interior designer?

Hauz Khas salons serve a style-aware crowd, often from compact shops or upper floors. A specialist plans the space so it looks distinctive, fits every station and still leaves room for clients to move comfortably.

Can a small salon space be made to feel bigger?

Yes. Mirrors, wall-mounted storage, slim stations and well-placed lighting make a compact salon feel open. We also plan wash areas and storage so the main floor stays clutter-free.

What lighting works best in a salon?

Even, shadow-free light at the mirrors for accurate colour work, softer light in waiting and spa areas, and accent light for retail shelves. We plan all three layers together.

Do you work on salon branding inside the space?

Yes. As your salon interior designer, we bring your logo, colours and style into the reception, feature walls and signage so the salon is easy to recognise.
